entries.title: Psalms 128:1
segments: A Song of degrees. Blessed [is] everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in His ways.

entries.title: Psalms 128:2
segments: For you shall surely eat the labor of your hands; you [shall be] happy, and all [is] well with you.

entries.title: Psalms 128:3
segments: Your wife [shall be] like a fruitful vine by the sides of your house; your sons [shall be] like olive plants around your table.

entries.title: Psalms 128:4
segments: Behold! So shall the man be blessed who fears the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 128:5
segments: The LORD shall bless you out of Zion; and you shall see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

entries.title: Psalms 128:6
segments: Yea, you shall see the sons of your sons. Peace [be] on Israel.
